item.title: Meta-Tool Convergence for Enterprise APIs and a Chained LLM Call Defense Line
item.description: This is a channel design note, scoped to the segment where a server-side enterprise system opens business capabilities to a large language model: how tools are organized, how calls are authorized, and how responses leave the channel. Prompt strategy on the model side and human confirmation in the orchestration layer are out of scope. Component names and step numbers correspond to a working implementation; organization, customer, and deployment details are omitted.
